title: Steelers' UFA tender for Aaron Rodgers is a chess move in a game no one knew about

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers' UFA tender for Aaron Rodgers is a chess move in a game no one knew about
sources.description: Pittsburgh's move to apply an unrestricted free agent tender to quarterback Aaron Rodgers becomes, in essence, a chess move in a game no one thought was being played.
